runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 16:51 sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. LinkedIn surfaced NATEK Salesforce CRM Support Manager, but it requires senior Salesforce platform ownership and was rejected on skill scope. SupportYourApp remote e-commerce/support results require fluent/C1 English and were rejected on language. Kariera surfaced several Bratislava admin listings, but the visible pay/role quality was below current LIVE threshold. Brigada surfaced current jobs outside the BA gate. StartupJobs surfaced MAGU roles centered on Prague. Public Reddit results were stale or supply-side; Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical freshness conflict detector
developmentChanges.reason: When an aggregator says a role was updated today but the canonical/LinkedIn listing is months old, track both timestamps and block <24h priority until the canonical publication/active state is verified. This prevents stale roles from repeatedly resurfacing as fresh.

developmentChanges.title: Remote jurisdiction evidence field
developmentChanges.reason: Store the exact evidence proving that a remote role can legally and operationally be performed from Slovakia (for example Remote from Slovakia, EU/EMEA including Slovakia, or Worldwide). Generic Remote without jurisdiction evidence should remain locationEligibility=unknown.
